findings.title: Preserve an explicit zero retry count
findings.summary: The job runner replaces a caller's zero retry count with the configured default.
findings.impact: Jobs explicitly configured for no retries run additional attempts, delaying final failure and repeating side effects.

evidence.observation: The truthiness fallback replaces an explicit zero retry count.

findings.cause_or_boundary: The runner uses truthiness instead of a null-only fallback for the retry count.
